claims.text: THE EMPLOYER IS DOCUMENTED AND THE EMPLOYEE IS NOT. Ford Motor Company's own corporate history records that Ford purchased Philco in 1961 and 'transferred its Aeronutronic Division to a new entity it called Philco-Ford'; that 'In 1963, the company went head-to-head against tech giants like IBM, RCA, Lockheed, Hughes Aircraft and AT&T in a bid to implement the Mission Control Center at the new Manned Space Center in Houston'; and that it was renamed Ford Aerospace and Communications Corporation in 1976 and sold to Loral in 1990.

claims.text: Philco-Ford, the contractor named in the Donna Hare claim, is documented as a NASA Manned Spacecraft Center contractor by Ford Motor Company's own corporate history, which records that it won the Mission Control Center contract at Houston in 1963 against IBM, RCA, Lockheed, Hughes Aircraft and AT&T.

edges.label: Carries the Wolfe and Hare claims about NASA imagery, against NASA's own records
edges.note: Wolfe's Lunar Orbiter account runs against the NSSDCA record that the programme was managed by NASA Langley Research Center. Hare's employer, Philco-Ford, is a documented NASA Manned Spacecraft Center contractor per Ford's own corporate history, while her employment is documented nowhere.
